description: This is a PHP source file defining functions related to setting up logic hooks for calendar synchronization in the SuiteCRM project. It includes the registration of hooks for 'after_save' and 'after_delete' events on the 'Meetings' module, referencing specific classes and external files for logic execution.

methods.name: install_calendar_sync_hooks
methods.description: Initializes the installation process for calendar synchronization hooks by invoking 'installCalendarSyncHooks'.

methods.name: installCalendarSyncHooks
methods.description: Defines and registers logic hooks for 'Meetings' module events 'after_save' and 'after_delete', passing hook details to 'check_logic_hook_file' for processing.
